_comment: Physical-edition part structure (user 2026-08-20): V1=2 parts, V2=2 parts, V3=3 parts, V4=1 part for now, V5-8=1 part each. Per user instruction, multi-part volumes are split EVENLY by chapter count and images assigned by their sequential physical-book names (coi_v1..coi_v8 = Tianwen Kadokawa books 1-8). (FYI: the only externally documented split is V1 at ch.75, the Webnovel free/VIP boundary — adjust ranges here if exact physical boundaries ever matter.) The old single-volume recovered images (coi_v1_nightmare/coi_v2_lightseeker/coi_v3_conspirer, extracted 2026-08-10 from rendered videos) remain in backgrounds/ as historical fallbacks. Art workflow: dropoff/ -> prepare_backgrounds.py -> edit here.
